name: io.github.chrischall/rxlocal-mcp
description: RxLocal pharmacy portal MCP — prescriptions, messages, confirm-gated refill requests

environmentVariables.name: RXLOCAL_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true to refuse the fetchproxy bridge read (CI/headless). Tools then fail instead of reading a session. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge connects to (default 37149). Shared by every MCP on the machine.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
